description: Information about technical vulnerabilities is not obtained, exposure evaluated, and measures taken.
applicability: Applies to organizations that do not actively identify, assess, prioritize, and remediate technical vulnerabilities in systems, applications, and network infrastructure through vulnerability scanning and patch management processes.

metadata.detection_notes: Review vulnerability scanning tools and schedules, patch management processes, vulnerability assessment reports, remediation timelines, security bulletin subscriptions, and tracking of known vulnerabilities (CVEs).
